title: AMR genes of clinical/public-health priority (illustrative starter list)
description: Matches CARD gene families (case-insensitive substring of the gene's geneFamily) or gene-name regular expressions. Includes a 'likely intrinsic / mutation model' category for genes to downweight. Curate for your context; variant-level interpretation (e.g. which SHV/TEM variants are ESBLs) needs the gene name and expert review.
